description: nf-core/crisprseq samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 2.3.0 schema. CRISPR editing analysis (targeted) and pooled screens (screening).

analysis.help: REQUIRED. targeted = edited a specific locus; screening = pooled sgRNA library screen.

protospacer.help: Run-level guide sequence; overrides any per-row protospacer. Use when the whole cohort shares one guide.

reference_fasta.help: Run-level amplicon FASTA path; overrides any per-row reference.

umi_clustering.help: Set true only if the libraries carry UMIs.

required_user_params.name: analysis
required_user_params.definition: Which kind of CRISPR experiment this is. Choose 'targeted' if you edited a specific locus and want editing efficiency at that site; choose 'screening' for a pooled sgRNA library screen.

required_user_params.name: protospacer
required_user_params.definition: The guide RNA target sequence (~20 nt), WITHOUT the PAM. If every sample in this cohort used the same guide, one value covers the whole run.
required_user_params.pattern_hint: DNA bases only (A/C/T/G/N) — no spaces, no 'U', and do not include the PAM

required_user_params.name: reference_fasta
required_user_params.definition: Path to a FASTA holding the wild-type amplicon sequence you sequenced across the cut site.

required_user_params.name: library
required_user_params.definition: Tab-separated file mapping each sgRNA to its target gene, for a pooled screen.

pipeline.name: nf-core/crisprseq
pipeline.core_rule: Only sample and fastq_1 are REQUIRED. reference / protospacer / template are optional per-row columns, and the run-level --protospacer and --reference_fasta override them.
pipeline.reference_requirement: No genome. crisprseq works against the supplied amplicon, not a whole-genome reference — so it needs nothing from the Luria refs tree.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
sample and fastq_1 must be populated; everything else is optional.
Sequence columns (reference/protospacer/template) must be DNA only: ^[ACTGNactgn]+$.
Prefer the run-level --protospacer / --reference_fasta when the cohort shares one guide and amplicon; only fall back to per-row columns when they genuinely differ.
If guides differ per sample, take them from an uploaded sheet — do NOT ask the user to type one sequence per row.
template is only needed for HDR / knock-in experiments; omit it for plain knockout.
Do NOT pass --gtf: crisprseq's schema has no gtf parameter.
notes: Editing-efficiency analysis. The failure mode to guard against is silent: a wrong protospacer does not error, it reports a wrong efficiency. Echo the captured values back to the user and get an explicit confirmation before submitting.

sources.label: nf-core/crisprseq nextflow_schema.json @ 2.3.0
sources.notes: Confirms analysis enum, and the run-level --protospacer / --reference_fasta overrides.

sources.label: nf-core/crisprseq assets/schema_input.json @ 2.3.0
sources.notes: Authoritative: only sample and fastq_1 are required; sequence columns are ^[ACTGNactgn]+$.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/crisprseq input samplesheet.

fastq_1.validation_hints: Absolute Luria path from the sample's primary-data metadata.

condition.description: Experimental condition label, e.g. edited vs control.
condition.validation_hints: Derive from the sample's Treatment/Cohort metadata when present.

reference.description: Per-sample wild-type amplicon sequence. Superseded by run-level --reference_fasta.
reference.validation_hints: Only use when amplicons genuinely differ across the cohort.

protospacer.description: Per-sample guide sequence without PAM. Superseded by run-level --protospacer.
protospacer.validation_hints: Only use when guides genuinely differ across the cohort.

template.description: HDR donor/repair template, for knock-in experiments only.
template.validation_hints: Omit entirely for plain knockout experiments.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/crisprseq samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort of CRISPR amplicon libraries.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected for CRISPR editing-efficiency or pooled-screen cohorts.
population_priority: One row per D.SEQ leaf; sample = the UID.
Map R1/R2 from the sample's primary-data metadata.
Fill `condition` from Treatment / Cohort metadata when it exists; leave blank otherwise.
Do NOT populate reference/protospacer/template from guesswork — those come from the user via required_user_params, or from an uploaded sheet.
final_checks: analysis has been answered by the user, not defaulted.
The captured guide/amplicon values have been echoed back and confirmed.
